content.hypothesis: Prioritizing search by receptacle type (e.g., checking all drawers before cabinets) yields a shorter path to the target than strictly following the spatial listing order in the initial observation.
content.realization_pattern: Type-based grouping followed by intra-group sequential traversal
content.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is hidden and multiple receptacle types are visible at entry.

content.hypothesis: Prioritizing semantically relevant open surfaces (countertops, sink basins) before closed cabinets reduces search steps for toiletries compared to spatial listing order or generic type-grouping.
content.realization_pattern: Semantic priority scan: Open surfaces -> Closed storage
content.scope: ALFWorld bathroom tasks where the target object is a toiletry (e.g., soap, toothpaste) and multiple closed storage receptacles are visible.
